name: Alfonso IX of León
role: King of León and Galicia from 1188 to 1230
contribution: King of León from the death of his father Ferdinand II in 1188 until his own death.
legacy: He took steps towards modernizing and democratizing his dominion and founded the University of Salamanca in 1218.

checks.lead: Alfonso IX (15 August 1171 – 23 or 24 September 1230) was King of León from the death of his father Ferdinand II in 1188 until his own death.
